decisions.reason: Because this XL anamnesis package is very close to the firm’s existing dental software and app capabilities, the firm can readily learn from early customer use and improve it through its in-house development, even if its appeal is somewhat narrower to larger practices.

Because this support service directly builds on the firm’s strong installed base, service know-how, and training capabilities, it fits its absorptive capacity especially well and is likely to be retained as a complementary offering.
